name: Love Olympus
source:
When Zeus chooses you as his target, you need to seduce another god to save your life. Who will you choose?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
當宙斯選中你作為目標，你就得勾引另一位神明才能保命。你會選誰？
